svg.title: Bilingual lockup — ṚTAM Foundation / ऋतम् प्रतिष्ठान (pure Sanskritic register)
svg.desc: Stacked bilingual lockup using the pure Sanskritic Devanagari form प्रतिष्ठान (pratiṣṭhāna — "established institution"), rather than the borrowed फाउंडेशन. For scholarly, sacred, or trust-deed contexts where the higher register is preferred.
